newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 10 percent slaughter cows and bulls; 12 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 67.25-76.00, pkg 79.50; two pkgs 700-800 lbs 66.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - few 250-300 lbs 86.00-91.00; 300-500 lbs 71.00-81.00, pkg 87.00; few 550-600 lbs 73.00.
Feeder Heifers - 600-650 lbs 66.00-72.25. Receipts - 555 Last Week - 259 Last Year - 469
